source.kind: Sanitized export of the project's private local controller usage index
source.scope: Main/root thread only; not a complete subordinate-agent or advisor account
source.backfill: Recorder retrospectively indexed earlier main-thread history
source.includes: Research, repeated cached context, subsequent analysis and reporting through the fixed cutoff
source.excludes: Later open/current work and any subordinate/advisor usage not captured in this main-thread index

token_semantics.per_request_capture: Native last_token_usage captured once when cumulative totals change
token_semantics.unattributed_note: Two initial July 29 events report total only; 14,819 + 12,708 = 27,527 tokens have no input/output attribution

recorded_elapsed_time.scope: Completed main-thread turns only; open/unclosed turns excluded
recorded_elapsed_time.precision: Hours rounded to six decimals in the saved aggregate
recorded_elapsed_time.note: Tool waits include awaited operations; these are not a separate independent duration to add to turn wall time, and do not identify how much awaited time was compute versus queue/idle.

recorded_execution_examples.workload: Selected fixed-motion notebook, one visible run
recorded_execution_examples.measurement_scope: Notebook execution including neural inference, I/O and motion refinement; not GPU-active time, training total or hidden-test runtime
Existing October 2 visible-prediction replay; excludes upstream inference/training and accesses no ground-truth labels

partial_scheduler_history.note: This narrow historical allocation subset cannot be substituted for the competition's training/inference compute total.

money.note: Unknown is not zero. Model interaction tokens or API list prices do not establish subscription payments, project invoices or cloud charges.

publication_boundary: Only sanitized aggregates are public. Raw transcripts, request identifiers, machine paths, usage databases, billing/account records and internal instructions are not included.
